title: Stand-up Update
description: Labelled extraction of one developer's stand-up message.

id.description: Unique id for this labelled example, e.g. upd-001

raw.description: Verbatim stand-up message exactly as the developer sent it

member_id.description: Developer identifier (use anonymised handle for eval set, e.g. dev-a)

standup_date.description: ISO date of the stand-up, e.g. 2026-10-21

source.description: Whether this update is from a real board or hand-written for coverage

done.description: Things the developer completed since the last stand-up

next.description: Things the developer plans to do today or next

blockers.description: Impediments mentioned; empty array if none

task_ids.description: Odoo task ids explicitly or implicitly referenced

commitments.description: Explicit promises with a date; empty array if none

notes.description: Labeller notes — edge cases, ambiguity, why a field was inferred

origin.description: reported = developer said it explicitly; inferred = derived from context

task_id.description: Odoo task id this item relates to, if known
Odoo task id this blocker is linked to

owner_id.description: Who is responsible for unblocking; null if unknown

task_id.description: Odoo task id as a string

mention.description: Exact text the developer used to reference this task, e.g. '#142' or 'the auth task'

due_date.description: ISO date the commitment is due; null only if date_type is implied and no next stand-up date is known

date_type.description: explicit = developer stated a date; implied = due next stand-up by default rule

task_id.description: Odoo task id this commitment is tied to
